rows.en:
(Hmm, with summer break this long,
I'm starting to run out of things to do...)
(Wait, huh? Is that Pinon-chan?)

\p?!
Wh-what are you doing in a place like this?
I was bored, so I was just wandering around.

I see, good for you...
Well, see you later......

W-wait up, Pinon-chan.
If you're free, let's go have fun somewhere...
I have important business to attend to now.
Can't I come along with you for that?
N-no! Don't you dare follow me!

Like I'd let you tag along when I'm going
to buy a swimsuit...
rows.notes: Muttered aside; the player doesn't catch it (c18941).

rows.en: Huh? Did you say something?
Nothing!

(Hmm... What was Pinon-chan's business
about, anyway?)

(Hmm, with summer break this long,
I'm starting to run out of things to do...)
I was bored, so I was just wandering around.
Can't I come along with you for that?

(Hmm... What was Pinon-chan's business
about, anyway?)

(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...
I'm finally going to meet the Galactic Fairy.)
C-can I have a moment? \p...
There's something I want to ask of you...
(It's rare for Pinon-chan to ask me for a favor.)

I-I'm sorry, but...
could you get Sheryl's autograph for me?!

An autograph?
Pinon-chan, are you a Sheryl fan?
S-so what if I am?!

Heh, no, nothing wrong with that.
I'll get one for you if I can, okay?

R-really?!
I'm counting on you!

(Pinon-chan being a Sheryl fan...
That's a little surprising.)

(I've got to get that autograph,
for Pinon-chan's sake.)

(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...
I'm finally going to meet the Galactic Fairy.)
(It's rare for Pinon-chan to ask me for a favor.)

(Pinon-chan being a Sheryl fan...
That's a little surprising.)

(I've got to get that autograph,
for Pinon-chan's sake.)

\p, \p!
Did you hear? They say a new planet's been found!

Yeah, I heard.
You look happy about the new planet too, Pinon-chan.

Hmph, of course I am!
They found a new planet we can live on!
This is a historic discovery!

What's this? \p,
aren't you happy they found a new planet?

It's not that...
I guess I'm still a little uneasy, though.

What a dummy you are.
I'm here, so what is there to be uneasy about?
Haha, you're right, Pinon-chan.

That's right.
Leave it to me, and there'll be no problems at all.

(I'm still a bit uneasy about the new planet...
but with Pinon-chan around, it's like having
a hundred people on my side, right?)

Yeah, I heard.
You look happy about the new planet too, Pinon-chan.

It's not that...
I guess I'm still a little uneasy, though.
Hehe, you're right, Pinon-chan.

(Haaah~...
I guess I really stayed up a bit too late last night.)

Yawning first thing in the morning...
How sloppy, \p.
Oh, good morning, Pinon-chan.

As a student of Mihoshi Academy,
you should shape up a bit more! Shape up!
Sorry, Pinon-sensei...

You need to live a proper, orderly life
like I do.
You go to bed at 9 p.m. sharp, and then...
Huh?! Nine?!

What are you so surprised about?
Everyone knows good kids are in bed by nine.

(That's way too early to go to bed...
Pinon-chan......)

(Haaah~...
I guess I really stayed up a bit too late last night.)

(That's way too early to go to bed...
Pinon-chan......)
(The city in this state... I don't want to believe it...)
I never thought it would be this bad...

\p...
Is there anything I can do
for the Frontier as it is now...?

There is...
After all, you're a genius, Pinon-chan.
I see... You're right.

All right! I'll do my best!
I'll work hard and restore this city!

Pinon-chan...
If there's anything I can help with, let me know.
Yeah, I'll count on you then.

(There must be something I can do too.
I've got to do my best as well!)
(The city in this state... I don't want to believe it...)

There is...
After all, you're a genius, Pinon-chan.

Pinon-chan...
If there's anything I can help with, let me know.

(There must be something I can do too.
I've got to do my best as well!)
